mapper.select: SELECT r.ROLE_ID AS role_cd, r.ROLE_NM AS role_name, (r.DATA_SCOPE_CD = 'PROJ') AS assigned_project_scope, (r.DATA_SCOPE_CD = 'PART') AS assigned_part_scope FROM TB_SY_ROLE r ORDER BY r.SORT_ORD, r.ROLE_ID

SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS project_id, p.PROJ_NM AS project_name, pm.user_id AS pm_user_id, pm.user_nm AS pm_name FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm FROM TB_SY_USER_SCOPE s JOIN TB_SY_USER_ROLE r ON r.user_id=s.user_id AND r.role_id='PM' JOIN TB_SY_USER u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.scope_type_cd='PROJ' AND s.proj_id=p.PROJ_ID ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 1 ) pm ON TRUE ORDER BY p.PROJ_NM, p.PROJ_ID
SELECT c.CODE AS code, c.CODE_NM AS name FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID = 'USER_STAT' ORDER BY c.SORT_ORD, c.CODE
